about: Draft charter F (23 Oct 2026): E, plus the light named plainly when it fits, feelings in layers, relief that returns is not failure, and the body gently wondered about. Same invented conversations as where-e.json.

conversations.name: uneasy-no-reason
said: I've felt uneasy all morning and I can't work out why
it's usually the traffic outside that sets me off but it's a quiet day
so maybe it isn't out there at all
I skipped breakfast and had three coffees, now that I think of it
huh. that might be most of it
I feel steadier just seeing that

conversations.name: heavy-coming-home
said: there's a heaviness that lands on me when I walk in my front door
I always thought it was the house, it's dark and cramped
but it's there even on sunny days
I think I carry the whole work day in with me
maybe I need a few minutes before I go in
sitting in the car for a bit could work

conversations.name: irritated-by-everyone
said: everyone is getting on my nerves lately, my partner especially
little things, the way they chew, the tv too loud
I haven't been sleeping well for about two weeks
I feel a bit guilty now
I'll go easier on them tonight
